transcript.content: Hello. What brings you in to see me today?

Well, I came in because my mind just feels... foggy lately. I work at the library, mostly doing clerical stuff, and I can't even seem to keep my place in my old cataloguing notes anymore. It's like I can't even decide what simple thing to do next. It's just getting really hard to think straight.
Have you been feeling down, depressed, or sad lately?

Yes, I have. Most days lately, I just sit at the kitchen table... and it feels like the color has just gone out of everything. I try to look at my old watercolor books, but they just make me feel heavy now instead of interested. It's just a very down, heavy feeling.
About how long have you been feeling this way?

Well, I'd say it's been about three months now. It's been pretty much most days. It really started right around the time I began getting things ready to leave the library. The low mood and the fogginess just sort of set in then, and they haven't really lifted since.
How has your sleep been over these past three months?

It hasn't been great, honestly. I go to bed feeling really tired, but then I just wake up around four in the morning. And I can't get back to sleep. I just lie there in the dark, thinking about what I'm supposed to do with myself now.
Have you ever had a period in your life before this where you felt this down or depressed?

No, I don't think so. I mean, sure, I've had a few bad days here and there over the years... just regular life stuff. But never anything like this. I haven't ever felt this heavy or stuck for months at a time before.
Have you ever had times in your life where you felt the opposite—extremely energetic, full of ideas, or on top of the world, needing very little sleep?

Well, actually... right after I retired, I did have a stretch of days sort of like that. I felt almost too bright and excited about things. But then I would get really sharp with my family over just small stuff. Like, if they asked me to slow down a bit, I'd just snap at them. So I guess I did feel a lot of energy then, just... maybe not in the best way.
How long did that period of high energy and irritability last?

I'm not exactly sure, to be honest. I didn't really keep track of it at the time. Maybe... a few days? Or a week? It's hard to remember exactly. I just know it went on for a little while and then it sort of faded out, but I couldn't give you an exact timeline.
During that time when you had so much energy, did you feel like you needed much less sleep than usual to feel rested?

Yes, I did. For several nights during that stretch, I was only sleeping maybe... three or four hours. But I didn't feel tired at all. I'd get right up feeling completely ready to work on whatever project I had going. It honestly just felt like sleep was getting in the way of everything I wanted to do.
